reviews.rationale: Replace nonstandard 文句する with attested 文句を言う while preserving stable runtime ID and intended complaint sense; repair both examples and dependent conjugation metadata.

examples.japanese: 意見を言っただけなのに、上司に「文句するな」と怒鳴られました。
examples.romaji: Iken o itta dake na noni, joushi ni monku suru na to donara remashita.
examples.german: Ich habe nur meine Meinung gesagt, aber mein Chef hat mich angeschrien: Beschwer dich nicht!

examples.japanese: いつも文句しないでください。
examples.german: Bitte beschweren Sie sich nicht ständig.

replacement.notes: Für „sich beschweren“ sagt man 文句を言う. 文句 ist hier ein Nomen mit を; das Verb 言う wird konjugiert: 文句を言います, 文句を言わない.

examples.japanese: 意見を言っただけなのに、上司に「文句を言うな」と怒鳴られました。
examples.romaji: Iken o itta dake na noni, joushi ni "monku o iu na" to donararemashita.
examples.german: Ich habe nur meine Meinung gesagt, aber mein Chef hat mich angeschrien: Beschwer dich nicht!

examples.japanese: いつも文句を言わないでください。
examples.german: Bitte beschweren Sie sich nicht ständig.

evidence.source: 小学館 プログレッシブ和英中辞典
evidence.attribution: Shogakukan; dictionary excerpt hosted by Kotobank
evidence.finding: Complaint sense explicitly uses 文句を言う for complain/object/find fault. Supports replacing invented 文句する while retaining intended German sich beschweren. Stable noun entry 文句 remains separate.
Existing disposition excludes 文句する because no supported modern verb class. Supporting JMdict noun 文句 supplies complaint sense; this does not establish a suru verb.

review.meaning: Preserve sich beschweren; publisher dictionary explicitly supports complaint phrase 文句を言う.
review.japanese: Repair quoted prohibition to 文句を言うな and polite negative request to 文句を言わないでください; both use the noun object 文句を with 言う.
review.romanization: monku o iu and monku o iwanaide match repaired Japanese; full example1 passive donararemashita agrees with 怒鳴られました.
review.translation: Existing German complaint translations remain faithful after correcting Japanese grammar.
contexts: Workplace complaint prohibition embedded in reported speech.
Polite request not to complain constantly.
review.lexical: Dictionary-attested phrase replaces unsupported suru construction; no extra sense or new runtime ID.
review.register: Ordinary complaint phrase; blunt quoted prohibition contrasted with polite request.
review.transitivity: 文句 is the object of 言う with を; whole phrase translates as intransitive sich beschweren.
review.conjugation: Godan 言う: いう, いいます, いわない, いって. Phrase metadata inflects final verb and preserves preceding もんくを.
review.level: Retain N4 estimate and original stable ID; no level reassignment.

secondPass.finding: Independently read Shogakukan Progressive4 complaint sense at https://kotobank.jp/jeword/%E6%96%87%E5%8F%A5: 文句を言う is the supported complain phrase. Corrected quoted workplace prohibition and polite habitual-complaint request preserve intended translations and provide distinct contexts. Checked romanization, necessary grammar note and actual engine forms: もんくをいいます, もんくをいわない, もんくをいって and もんくをいうな. Stable ID retained and no phrase collision; noun 文句 remains separate. Exact whole-phrase pitch unavailable, so null prevents an unsupported inherited accent claim.
